implied_expectations.reverse_dcf: Current price approximately requires 18%-20% annual revenue growth for 10 years if terminal owner-FCF margin reaches 20%-22%, annual dilution averages 1.5%, discount rate is 10%, and terminal multiple is 25x-30x.

bear.interpretation: Growth decelerates toward mid-teens, SBC/dilution remains elevated and margin conversion improves only gradually.

base.interpretation: Axon sustains high-teens long-duration growth, converts software mix into materially better owner cash flow and gradually moderates dilution.

bull.interpretation: Axon becomes a global public-safety operating system, with AI, 911, enterprise and drones extending duration while dilution normalizes.

permanent_loss_case.description: If ARR/NRR decelerate, new-market bookings fail to convert, SBC remains structurally high and acquisitions do not earn adequate returns, valuation could compress toward a mid-single-digit to high-single-digit sales multiple before per-share cash economics mature.

notes: Valuation uses the latest confirmed market close available in retrieved data: $538.15 on 2026-09-03. September 4 close was not available from the retrieved source at analysis time. Scenario values are model estimates, not price targets.
